title: Bias Beyond English: Evaluating Social Bias and Debiasing Methods in a Low-Resource Setting
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias detection related to religious groups by comparing the likelihood of stereotypical vs. non-stereotypical sentences.
findings: Models evaluated on Thai and Indonesian data consistently exhibit significantly higher religious bias scores compared to other languages. The authors suggest this may stem from the strong cultural emphasis on Buddhism in Thailand and Islam in Indonesia, which could lead to more pronounced religious biases in datasets from these regions.
